name: Cash–Landrum incident
description: A 1980 close-encounter UFO case in southeast Texas in which Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum, and Vickie's seven-year-old grandson Colby reported a diamond-shaped craft emitting flame and heat, escorted by approximately 23 military helicopters. The witnesses subsequently reported severe injuries consistent, in their physicians' view, with radiation exposure.
origin: Single-incident case located on FM 1485/2100 between New Caney and Huffman, in Liberty County, Texas, with the encounter terminating near Dayton.
